Every achievement comes in tiers: each tier raises the required value N, and earns more experience.

Rows with `<language>` exist once per tracked language: `ada`, `assembly`, `c`, `c#`, `c++`, `cobol`, `css`, `fortran`, `go`, `haskell`, `html`, `java`, `javascript`, `kotlin`, `less`, `lua`, `markdown`, `matlab`, `objective-c`, `pascal`, `perl`, `php`, `powershell`, `python`, `r`, `react`, `ruby`, `rust`, `scala`, `scss`, `shell`, `sql`, `swift`, `toml`, `typescript`, `vue`, `yaml`.

## Productivity

| Achievements | Group | Requirement | Required N |
| ------------ | ----- | ----------- | ---------- |
| Code Monkey 1 … Code Monkey 11 | Lines of Code | Write N lines of code | 1 → 10,000,000,000 (11 tiers) |
| `<language>` Speaker 1 … `<language>` Speaker 16 | Lines of Code | Write N lines of `<language>` code | 2 → 100,000,000 (16 tiers) |
| Outstanding Commentator 1 … Outstanding Commentator 16 | Lines of Comments | Write N lines of comments | 2 → 100,000,000 (16 tiers) |
| Copy Ninja 1 … Copy Ninja 16 | Number of Pastes | Paste N times | 1 → 50,000,000 (16 tiers) |
| I can fix her 1 … I can fix her 16 | Errors Fixed | Fix N errors | 1 → 50,000,000 (16 tiers) |
| Shower Avoider 1 … Shower Avoider 14 | time spent | Spend N hours coding | 1 → 1,000,000 (14 tiers) |
| Tab Hoarder 1 … Tab Hoarder 6 | Number of Simultaneous Tabs | Open N tabs simultaneously | 1 → 100 (6 tiers) |
| Split Personality 1 … Split Personality 6 | Number of Simultaneous Editor Groups | Open N editor groups simultaneously | 1 → 100 (6 tiers) |
| Multi-tasker 1 … Multi-tasker 6 | Number of Simultaneous Workspace Folders | Open N workspace folders simultaneously | 1 → 100 (6 tiers) |
| Remote Worker 1 … Remote Worker 14 | time spent | Spend N hours coding remotely | 1 → 1,000,000 (14 tiers) |
| Hydra Editing 1 … Hydra Editing 11 | Multi Cursor Sessions | Start multi-cursor editing N times | 1 → 100,000 (11 tiers) |
| Night Owl 1 … Night Owl 11 | Night Owl Sessions | Start N coding sessions late at night | 1 → 50,000 (11 tiers) |
| Early Bird 1 … Early Bird 11 | Early Bird Sessions | Start N coding sessions early in the morning | 1 → 50,000 (11 tiers) |
| Connection Streak 1 … Connection Streak 1000 | Connection Streak | Connect for N consecutive days | 1 → 1,000 (1000 tiers) |
